body_html:
Bryan has a passion for music and loves to direct that passion towards crafting unique DJ experiences for any event. He has been in the entertainment business since 2003 and has a knowledgeable background in Music Production and Music History.

Bryan’s experience has come from performing at numerous:

Fundraisers
Benefit Auctions
School Dances
Night Clubs
Weddings
Trivia

And much more!

In addition to JAMMIN” DJs, Bryan has worked with many of Denver’s best local musicians to provide exceptional experiences at numerous venues across Georgia. His goal is interact with people on a level fit to provide the most memorable experiences possible! With a genuine drive to please, his motto is “As long as I’m making someone smile I’m making myself smile.”
